Strong expertise in Shopify Liquid, BigCommerce Stencil, GraphQL, REST APIs, Checkout Extensions, Shopify Flow, and Deluge scripting, with hands-on experience in platform migrations, headless commerce implementations, ERP integrations, and performance optimization. Proven ability to develop custom storefront experiences, automate business workflows, and implement scalable wholesale and dealer management systems integrated with Zoho Inventory, Zoho Books, and third-party platforms. Experienced in leading end-to-end development lifecycle activities including architecture planning, frontend engineering, backend integrations, SEO optimization, API orchestration, and post-launch support in fast-paced client delivery environments.
